## 3. Persistence model

### SQLite `fieldmaps-shell.db` (expo-sqlite, `SCHEMA_VERSION = 6`, `storage/database-migrations.ts:5`)

One shared connection. All operations are serialized by `databaseWrite` (`storage/database-write.ts:7-12`). WAL, `busy_timeout=5000` (`database-migrations.ts:60`). No SQLCipher or encryption. No change listeners (grep).

`owner_scope` is `JSON.stringify([apiUrl, issuer, userId, projectId])` (`sync/contracts.ts:12-14`), built by `legacyScope()` with hard-coded values: apiUrl `http://127.0.0.1:8000`, issuer `https://lezmqhuucfwqknspgcdy.supabase.co/auth/v1`, project `10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002` (`data/legacy/scope.ts:4-11`). Only `userId` varies. This is the same in development, staging and production builds. It is "frozen until MOB-11" (`:3`; README "Legacy SQLite `owner_scope` keys remain frozen"). With no account, key = `"local"` (`auth/session-retention.ts:30`).

### Package install and verification (`PACKAGE-LIFECYCLE.md:9-11`)

1. `GET /v1/projects/{p}/sites` returns `package.archive_bytes` and `archive_sha256` (`hosted/schemas.ts:37-50`).
2. Download zip natively to cache (`device.ts:116-122`). Check length and SHA-256 of bytes (`prepare.ts:26-32`, digest via expo-crypto `device.ts:48`). The digest comes from the same API as the archive.
3. `fflate.unzipSync`; strict manifest; layers ground/paths/trees/zones (`archive.ts:12,24-47`).
4. Manifest identity must match the site row (`verify-bound.ts:67-82`). One site polygon (`package-camera.ts:14-16`).
5. Zones: count, duplicate id/code, per-zone `geometry_sha256` over canonical JSON, bbox, <=2000 vertices per zone, <=20000 total (`verify-bound.ts:9-60`).
6. Forms fetched separately (`GET .../form-versions/{code}`) and checked: code, `version_id`, not draft, published (`:83-97`).
7. Written once as a single JSON via stage + `moveSync(overwrite:false)`; `contentSha256` stored in catalog metadata (`installation.ts:106-159`, `device.ts:34-36`). Cancellation is checked inside the DB transaction (`package-catalog.ts:61,102-104`).
8. Every `catalog()` load re-reads, re-hashes and re-validates (`installation.ts:71-104`). A failure shows `needs_redownload`.

Removal (`package-catalog.ts:126-160`): refused while any session lease, draft (active or parked) or record (any state) references the package. Otherwise it deletes only the `package_selections` and `package_authorizations` rows. `package_contents` and the files remain (`contentRetained:true` always). There is no file garbage collection.

## 4. Sync / outbox

**Persisted states** (`domain/observation.ts:19`): `local-only`, `pending`, `synced`, `needs-attention`. There is **no `uploading` state in SQLite**. Initial state: `pending` if bound (has `binding`), else `local-only` (`observation-store.ts:27-31`, `forms/registry.ts:30-32`). Practice and bundled records have no `projectId` and stay `local-only` forever; key `"local"` is also `local-only`.

**Transitions**

| From -> to | Trigger | Code |
|---|---|---|
| (new) -> `pending`/`local-only` | Save: `commitObservation` inserts record and deletes its draft in one transaction | `observation-store.ts:63-77` |
| `local-only` -> `pending` | `activateHeldObservations` before each drain, for bound rows of the same issuer/user/project | `sync-store.ts:43-78` |
| `pending` -> `synced` | 2xx and receipt matches (observation, user, project, package, zone) | `coordinator.ts:44-52,55-63`, `sync-store.ts:80-106` |
| `pending` -> `pending` | `retry` and `sign-in` results: `attempts+1`, `sync_error`=message, `next_attempt_at` | `sync-store.ts:108-130` |
| `pending` -> `needs-attention` | `rejected` result (4xx domain codes) | same, `rejected=true` |
| `needs-attention`/`pending` -> `pending` | Manual retry: `sync_error=''`, `next_attempt_at=0`. `attempts` is not reset, so backoff stays escalated | `sync-store.ts:131-151` |

`needs-attention` rows are not selected by `pendingObservations` (`sync_state='pending'`, `next_attempt_at<=now`, `LIMIT 25`, `sync-store.ts:31-40`), so a rejection is terminal until manual retry.

**Uploader** (`sync/provider.tsx:28-149`): foreground only, no background task (no task-manager dependency; README says there is no closed-app background upload).

- Preconditions: `ready`, session present, client, not deleted, `session.user.id === scope.userId` (`:34-39`).
- Wake triggers: save (`observation-actions.ts:222`), `AppState` -> active (`:117-121`), NetInfo online (`:122-126`, `online = isConnected && isInternetReachable !== false`), **5 s `setInterval`** (`:127-129`), manual `retry` (`records.tsx:151`), token change (effect deps include `sessionToken`, `:139`).
- Backgrounding or going offline aborts the in-flight request (`:119`, `:124`). `createForegroundDrain` coalesces wakes (`sync/foreground.ts`).
- Coordinator (`coordinator.ts:22-99`): fenced by `signal.aborted`/`isCurrent()` around every await; one runner (`running`); loops batches of 25. Gets a fresh token per item via `client.auth.getSession()` (`provider.tsx:81-87`); null token returns without changing the row.
- Backoff on `retry`/`rejected`/`sign-in`: `next_attempt_at = now + max(retryAfter*1000, min(300000, 5000 * 2^min(attempts,6)))` (`coordinator.ts:72-77`). A `sign-in` result sets `signInRequired` and stops that coordinator instance until it is rebuilt (`:84-87`).
- Request: `PUT {apiUrl}/v1/projects/{projectId}/observations/{observationId}`, Bearer token, body = the persisted `uploadBody`. ky `retry:0`, timeout 15 s (`bound-upload.ts:10-32`). Before sending, `uploadBodyMatches` re-checks the stored body against the record (`wire-body.ts:61-102`). Body fields: site/package/zone ids, `form_version` code, observer, `observed_at` (= `createdAt`), answers, `round_type`, `placement`, `first_round`, `coordinates` (`wire-body.ts:10-28`).
- **Idempotency**: the client-generated UUID in the URL path plus the frozen body, re-sent unchanged after a lost response. No `Idempotency-Key` header. Server codes `conflict`/`idempotency_conflict` exist (`data/api/errors.ts:18-22`).
- **Receipt**: zod `receiptSchema` (`accepted_revision` must be literal 1) and `receiptMatches` checked in `bound-upload.ts:34-36`, again in `coordinator.ts:44-52`, again in `acknowledge` (`sync-store.ts:97-98`). A mismatch counts as `retry`.
- **Rejections** (`data/api/errors.ts:83-124`): 401/`unauthenticated`/`token_invalid` -> `sign-in`; 5xx/`rate_limited`/`internal`/`storage_unavailable` -> `retry`; 429 forced to `retry` (`upload-failure.ts:48`); all other codes (incl. `membership_required`, `account_deleted`, `validation_failed`, `conflict`, `payload_too_large`) -> `rejected` -> `needs-attention`. Issue codes (`point_outside_zone` etc.) map to "Needs attention. …" copy (`upload-failure.ts:15-28`), stored as JSON `{message,code,issueCodes}` in `sync_error` (`sync-store.ts:123`). - `themes.day` and `themes.dusk`: 31 colour tokens each, identical key sets: ground, island, well, ledge, line, rule, edge, ink, ink2, onInk, accent, accentSoft, onAccent, nav, onNav, navCurrent, onNavCurrent, focus, focusGap, scrim, saved, savedSoft, waiting, waitingSoft, uploaded, uploadedSoft, attention, attentionSoft, onAttention, held, heldSoft. Only `scrim` carries alpha (`day` #13201952, `dusk` #00000080).
- `derived`: `day` lists 10 names (onInk, onAccent, nav, onNav, navCurrent, onNavCurrent, focus, focusGap, scrim, onAttention); `dusk` lists 11 names (rule, edge, onInk, accentSoft, onNav, navCurrent, onNavCurrent, focus, focusGap, scrim, onAttention). See C2.
- `contrast`: `text` has 29 pairs (4.5:1 minimum), `ui` has 6 pairs (3:1 minimum). Text pairs include ink/ground, ink/island, ink/well, accent/ground, onAccent/accent, onNav/nav, saved/island, saved/savedSoft, and the same pattern for waiting, uploaded, attention and held. UI pairs: edge/island, edge/ground, focus/ground, focus/island, ink/island, accent/island.
- `font`: sans Geologica, mono Spline Sans Mono, weights 400/500/600. Read by no code (see 3.3).
- `type`: `web` has 15 roles (display, hero, auth, page, section, question, island, lead, answer, body, small, monoLabel, monoData, monoCode, monoTitle); `mobile` has 13 roles (adds bodyStrong and smallStrong; has no hero, auth, section or lead).

- `motion`: `duration` (11 keys, ms), `easing` (standard, exit, reveal, linear), `reducedFade` (100).

## 3. Token pipeline

### 3.1 Flow

1. `contracts/contour.json` is the hand-authored source.
2. Root `tokens` (`package.json:45`) runs `node scripts/contour-tokens.mjs`, which writes `web/src/styles/contour.css` (283 lines; generated header comment at lines 1-2 of the output, "do not edit by hand").
3. Root `tokens` then runs `pnpm emails:generate` (`package.json:47`), which runs `backend/Makefile:9-10`, i.e. `fieldmaps_api.email.generate`. That copies `contracts/contour.json` into `backend/src/fieldmaps_api/email/contour.json` (`generate.py:17-24`) and renders the `AUTH_CONTENT` templates into `supabase/templates/` (`generate.py:26-34`; 13 HTML files are present there).
4. Consumers:
   - `web/src/app/globals.css:2` imports `../styles/contour.css`. Tailwind utilities map the colour, radius, spacing, motion and type variables (`globals.css:1-18` and below).
   - `web/src/lib/contour.ts:1` imports the contract at runtime. It exports the state vocabulary, `stateOf()` (lines 28-34) and `MOTION` (line 36).
   - `mobile/src/ui/tokens.ts:2` imports `contracts/contour.json` directly at runtime (no generated file). It exports `DEFAULT_SCHEME` (line 15), `TYPE` (32), `SPACE` (35-45), `RADIUS`/`SIZE`/`LAYOUT` (47-49), `MOTION` (58-67) and state helpers (69-120).

### 3.2 What `scripts/contour-tokens.mjs --check` verifies

- Builds the whole stylesheet in memory and compares it byte-for-byte with `web/src/styles/contour.css` (lines 162-179). Any drift, including an empty file, fails.
- Contrast (lines 56-78): for each theme in `contract.themes`, for `text` (min 4.5) and `ui` (min 3) pairs from `contract.contrast`. A pair naming a colour the theme lacks is reported (line 66). Hex is parsed with `slice(0, 7)` (line 69), so alpha is discarded.
- Exit code 1 on any problem (lines 175-177). Generate mode also reports contrast problems but writes the file first (lines 181-186).
- Root `tokens:check` (`package.json:46`) runs this, then `pnpm emails:check` (`backend/Makefile:12-13` runs `generate --check`, which byte-compares the backend contour copy and the HTML templates, `generate.py:19-32`).

### 3.3 What it does NOT check

- `derived` is read by no code (grep for `.derived` in web/src, mobile/src and scripts returns nothing). Derived values are contrast-checked only if they appear in a listed pair.
- Only the 35 listed pairs are checked. Uses outside the list are unchecked, e.g. accent text on accentSoft or well, saved or waiting on ground, nav/navCurrent against ground.
- Alpha: `slice(0, 7)` treats any alpha colour as opaque. Today the only alpha value is `scrim`, which is in no pair.
- Day/Dusk key parity is not checked. A key missing from one theme is caught only when a pair names it.
- Not emitted or checked by the generator: `font` (read by no code; fonts are hard-coded at `web/src/app/layout.tsx:4-20` and `mobile/src/ui/fonts.ts:8-10`), `space` (read only by mobile, `tokens.ts:36-44`; the web stylesheet has no 9-step space variables), `states` (read by TypeScript only; tone and icon names are not validated against theme keys or Lucide), `type.mobile`, `layout.mobile`, `radius.mobile`, `size.mobile`.
- Map palettes (`map-palettes.json`) have no contrast check in this script. Handle contrast is tested separately in `web/tests/unit/zone-editor-chrome.test.mjs:115-130` and the mobile palette test.
- The script does not validate the JSON schema of `contour.json`; a missing block throws at runtime.
- Not run in CI (see 5.2).

### 3.4 Value spot check of checked-in `contour.css` (read-only, not the generator)

- 62 of 62 colour variables (31 day, 31 dusk) equal the `contour.json` values.
- Radius (pill 9999px for 999), spacing (control, control-sm, touch, table-header, table-row, gutter, island-pad, header), motion durations and easing curves match.
- The 15 `@utility type-*` names match `type.web` keys.

## 5. Honesty and voice checklist (testable)

Sources: `PRODUCT.md:78-134`, `DESIGN.md:61-70,845-902,946-967`, `web/AGENTS.md:19-30`, `contracts/contour.json` `states`.

Honesty (`PRODUCT.md:82-99`)
- [ ] Every save/error/empty state says where the work is: on this device / uploading / uploaded / held; phone errors lead with that.
- [ ] "Uploaded" only after server acknowledgment; "Synced" never used.
- [ ] "Ready offline" only when map, zone boundaries, form definition and field guide all verify.
- [ ] Device readiness on web shows "not available", never a guess.
- [ ] Overview/Reports counts say records still on devices are not counted.
- [ ] Collector header shows real map and form versions.
- [ ] Web shows no fixtures/sample/Preview marker; a failed read is `LoadFailure`, never an empty list.
- [ ] Capped/loaded-subset numbers say so (current wording in code: "counted from the newest N", "The map shows the N loaded of M matching").
- [ ] Unbuilt features render one `NotAvailable` note (reason + alternative), never a disabled/fake button.
- [ ] Android link only when `NEXT_PUBLIC_ANDROID_APP_URL` is an https URL; no store links otherwise.
- [ ] Coverage claims only records present; no target claimed (U6).
- [ ] No fabricated verification of production, device or background sync.

Voice (`PRODUCT.md:101-134`, `DESIGN.md:845-902`)
- [ ] Buttons verb+object, sentence case; no bare OK/Submit/Yes.
- [ ] No "Oops", exclamation marks, "successfully", blame.
- [ ] Errors: what happened, what is safe, what to do.
- [ ] Disabled control shows its reason in a visible line directly below (web `aria-disabled`+`aria-describedby`).
- [ ] Destructive: consequences listed before type-to-confirm; irreversible button is `danger-filled`.
- [ ] Mono for IDs/versions/codes/counts ("things you might read aloud"); times carry context.
- [ ] Glossary: Project/Site/Zone/Form+versions/Map package/Observation/Round/Observer code/Training; avoid Study, Place, Instrument, Package (for place), Entry, Visit, Demo, "Assigned", Synced, Pending, Failed (`PRODUCT.md:62-76`).
- [ ] Queue states exactly: On device, Uploading, Uploaded, Needs attention, Held ("waits on the project, not on the observer"); review states: Not yet reviewed, Approved, Excluded (`DESIGN.md:534-550`).

Design rules (`DESIGN.md:61-70`)
- [ ] One filled magenta action per screen; ink/outline for others.
- [ ] State = glyph + word + colour; no colour-only state.
- [ ] No state colours inside map canvases; violet outside maps only in legend/brand mark.
- [ ] Labels wrap: no ellipsis/line-clamp/`numberOfLines`.
- [ ] Day default, no OS-dark-mode following; Dusk only by choice; map palette independent of theme.
- [ ] Targets >=44 web / >=48 mobile / 48-60 collector (`DESIGN.md:212-223`); focus ring 3 px + 3 px gap; skip link; reduced motion (movement 0, fades <=100 ms); no shimmer/spinner/hover lift/gradient/glass/side stripe; determinate progress only.
- [ ] WCAG AA 4.5:1 text / 3:1 UI both themes (`pnpm tokens:check`); axe no serious/critical; VoiceOver covers sign in > join > place > answer > review > save (`PRODUCT.md:158-163`).
- [ ] Tokens only (no hex outside `contour.css`, `tokens.ts`, `map-palettes.json`, brand artwork).
